For ORCH and the owner (closed questions, M0 report): (а) residual risk (7): keep a call-class value as it is (named residual risk, owner's answer 30(а) as the basis) or close it; data from my implementation: reading a call value with `&` or `=` after the opening parenthesis as a literal refuses none of the 114 keep records and none of the nine plan samples; (б) residual risk (4)/F1: a real secret made of letters, digits, `_`, `.`, `-` that contains example or starts with your is kept as a placeholder; accept and name it, or narrow the two rules (for example, to a whole segment) — the amendment as written does not decide it.

The totals 118 keep and 125 refuse of the task are the totals of the design oracle tables plus the new groups (reproduced, 0 wrong). The description lists 114 and 126 entries by my enumeration; the requirement does not state either total, so no text is wrong; the oracle tables of the design are an aid and stay the design author's to correct (the requirement wins).

Compatibility of criteria (AP-016/017): none of the new pairs and samples contradicts another; the pairs of criterion 3 (E13) and the lists of О26/С26 in the description give the same 12 and 17 records (checked by hand against my lists: 8 keep halves plus 4 «остальные» = 12; 6 refuse halves plus 10 «остальные» plus the quoted `your ` pair = 17). The criteria remain possible together; the 120 s budget of criterion 7 is unchanged and the amendment adds no family.

Facts of the task checked (quality bar 6.2): 103 requirements, ids unique, REQ-102 12 criteria pending: true; the 16 edits reverse to the file with sha256 350745f6...: true; the rest-of-file hash 18a08a65... for NR<12406||NR>13043: true; the three README greps are 0 on the tag and on the tree: true; 118 and 125: true as totals of the oracle tables. Nothing in the task contradicted the files.
